title: Anchorage Curling Club
gap: Price details for leagues, bonspiels, and programs not stated
blurb: The club operates a 2-sheet curling facility with ice from October through April. They offer leagues six nights a week for all skill levels, bonspiels throughout the season, and Learn to Curl programs in October and January. There is also a Sunday Juniors Program for curlers under 18 with two 6-session terms.
